description: Angular component for configuring an entity count widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, default configuration, and output preparation.

classes.name: EntityCountBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring entity count widgets.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the widget configuration.

methods.name: setupDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default datasource and data key for the widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Sets up the form with current configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data for output.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the card button options in the widget configuration.
